title: Chapter 385: Fight To The Death
content:
Chapter 385: Fight To The Death

"Dad, what are you doing? I'm Xiaoxue."

In the distance, Lu Xue wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and smiled miserably at Lu Daosheng.

At the same time, countless figures suddenly gathered towards here.

Kong and Ao Qing had already stood behind Lu Daosheng at some point, and An Changzai looked at Lu Xue with a serious expression on his face.

"What's wrong."

"It's very wrong."

"I'm afraid the palace master has been taken over, right?"

Kong didn't say anything, but just stood quietly behind Lu Daosheng.

No matter what decision the city lord makes, he will definitely support it unconditionally.

Ao Qing looked worried and hurriedly asked Lu Daosheng: "Master, what's wrong with Xiaozhu?"

At this time, the strong men of the human race and the strong men of the deserted city rushed over.

After coming here, everyone was confused when they saw Lu Xue confronting everyone.

What exactly happened?

Yan Lingyun walked to Lu Daosheng with a calm face, "What's going on?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng's expression had gradually returned to calm.

He grabbed Yan Lingyun's beautiful hand and used a little force to signal her to be at ease.

"It seems that I am still too weak. I am bullied by you and came to the door."

Lu Daosheng's calm words rang out from the scene.

When everyone heard this, they felt extremely depressed.

Everyone in the deserted city was extremely shocked.

The city lord was really angry this time.

In the distance, Lu Xue still maintained that calm smile. She looked at Lu Daosheng and chuckled, "Your daughter is a good container."

"Don't worry, I will take good care of your daughter."

After saying this, Lu Xue turned her head and prepared to leave.

"Did I let you go?"

"Um?"

Lu Xue stopped and slowly looked back.

She still had confidence on her face, "No one in this world can keep me?"

Lu Daosheng sneered, "It will be your decision to make the last regret in your life."

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng's aura suddenly began to surge.

Everyone around, including Lu Xue, was shocked by this scene.

As the space around Lu Daosheng gradually shattered into nothingness, when everyone reacted, Lu Daosheng had disappeared from the spot.

"Huh? Miss is gone!"

After everyone was shocked, they immediately reacted.

It seems that the city lord has taken action.

So what are they doing now?

For a moment, everyone looked at Yan Lingyun. At this moment, no one else could compare to Yan Lingyun.

Feeling everyone's gaze, Yan Lingyun pondered for a moment, then comforted her, "Xiaoxue will be fine, but after this time, I may be busy in Huangcheng again."

After hearing Yan Lingyun's words, everyone breathed a sigh of relief and the big stone in their hearts fell.

As for what Yan Lingyun said, I was busy again.

Most people in the deserted city still have no choice but to do this. Life is really boring when practicing in the deserted city every day.

at the same time.

In an illusory space.

Two figures looked at each other from afar.

"What trick are you?"

"Lu Xue"'s face was slightly dark, and his light kept looking at this strange space.

Her escape method actually lost its effect here.

Of course, it may also be that Lu Xue's body is too weak and many methods are not used.

But even so, it shocked her enough.

In the distance, Lu Dao's intention to kill himself suddenly appeared, and he spoke hideously, "You shouldn't have done anything, and what you shouldn't have done is to touch my daughter."

"Today, this is your burial place."

Hearing this, "Lu Xue" was a little disdainful, "Do you know what I exist? If you want to kill me like this, you don't know the frog in the well that is so thick."

Lu Daosheng was not angry at all about "Lu Xue"'s provocation, but instead showed a strange smile.

"God, don't worry, I will go to the land of Gods sooner or later. I hope that when I get there, you will still be as confident as you are today."

"However, your will to practice for many years, stay here today."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng suddenly took action, and the terrifying and boundless power no longer restrained at all.

Feeling the power of almost despair, "Lu Xue" looked a little shocked, "You actually have this kind of strength."

Buzz —

A wave of turmoil was condensed around Lu Xue, trying to block Lu Daosheng's power.

But Lu Daosheng's power had no resistance at all, and he directly swallowed Lu Xue.

boom!

The space exploded.

Lu Xue stood there, her body emitting a strange glow.

She was safe and sound, but her eyes narrowed slightly, as if she was in a deep sleep.

But far away from Lu Xue, a blurry phantom was in a mess. She was hit by Lu Daosheng and then was constantly destroyed by that force.

She wanted to escape, but here she became a turtle in a jar and had nowhere to escape.

"You will regret it, God cannot be humiliated."

At this moment, she was still trying to shock Lu Daosheng.

She had no idea what she was facing.

Lu Daosheng chuckled, no longer taking her seriously.

He grabbed the phantom in his hand.

With a slight force, the phantom let out a hideous scream.

"What, does God know that pain?"

"You have no regrets!"

"It's a pity that you are just a will, no matter how hard you play, it's boring, but don't worry, your original body will come to you soon."

Lu Daosheng shook his head and then exerted a light force.

With a click.

This will completely dissipate.

......

At this time, when I heard what Yan Lingyun said, there were many people who were busy in the future, and they were still fantasizing about their future life.

You can fight and kill again.

Some militants laughed in their hearts.

But the next moment, fluctuations came from the distant space.

I saw Lu Daosheng slowly appeared in everyone's sight, holding the unconscious Lu Xue.

So fast!

Everyone was shocked, and then they quickly reacted.

"Master Lord!"

"Lord of the Palace!"

Everyone surrounded him and breathed a sigh of relief when they saw Lu Xue just unconscious.

Yan Lingyun took Lu Xue and then took a step back.

Lu Daosheng nodded at Yan Lingyun before looking at the rest of the people.

Lu Daosheng's face changed and he spoke in a deep voice: "From today, my deserted city and the land of the gods will never stop until death!"

"Don't die!"

"Don't die!"

Although most people don’t know what the land of the gods is, it’s right to shout it.

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly took off and came to the void.

He looked at the Chaos Realm under his feet, his expression gradually became cold.

"You damn beasts, who claim to be God, really do nothing in human affairs."

Lu Daosheng's palm was facing down, and a suffocating force suddenly poured down.

In an instant, the entire Chaos Realm was baptized by this force.

The three gods that stood tall in the Chaos Realm for endless years were completely destroyed at this moment.
